   Investment Holding Company Limited ( “Weigao                           包 裝 製 品 有 限 公 司（「威 高 包 裝」）
   International”) which is the holding company of Weigao                 100%股 權。威 高 國 際 同 意 向 威 高
   Holding. Weigao International agreed to make a total                   普 瑞 合 計 注 資 人 民 幣 66,110,000

             The measurement of ECL is a function of the                   預期信貸虧損之計量為

             the magnitude of the loss if there is a default)              違 約 時 虧 損 大 小）及 違 約

             of the probability of default and loss given                  概率及違約虧損之評估
             default is based on historical data adjusted                  乃基於歷史數據按前瞻
             by forward-looking information. Estimation                    性資料作調整。預期信貸
             of ECL reflects an unbiased and probability-                  虧損的預估乃無偏概率
             weighted amount that is determined with the                   加權平均金額，以各自發
             respective risks of default occurring as the                  生違約的風險為權重確
             weights. The Group uses a practical expedient                 定。本集團使用可行權宜
             in estimating ECL on trade receivables using                  方法，運用撥備矩陣預估
             a provision matrix taking into consideration                  應收貿易賬款之預期信
             historical credit loss experience, adjusted for               貸虧損，當中考慮過往信
             forward looking information that is available                 貸損失經驗，並就毋須繁
             without undue cost or effort.                                 苛成本或工作即可獲得
                                                                           之前瞻性資料作出調整。

             Generally, the ECL is the difference between                  一般而言，預期信貸虧損
             all contractual cash flows that are due to the                為根據合約應付本集團
             Group in accordance with the contract and                     的所有合約現金流與本
             the cash flows that the Group expects to                      集團預期將收取的現金
             receive, discounted at the effective interest                 流之間的差額，並按初始
             rate determined at initial recognition. For                   確認時釐定的實際利率
             a lease receivable, the cash flows used for                   貼現。就租賃應收款項而
